                              - [Text] import { tool } from "ai";
import z from "zod";
import { desktop } from "../../desktop";
import * as Terminator from "@mediar-ai/terminator";
import path from "node:path";
import { writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";

type UINode = {
  id?: string;
  attributes?: {
    role?: string;
    name?: string;
    bounds?: {
      x: number;
      y: number;
      width: number;
      height: number;
    };
    isKeyboardFocusable?: boolean;
  };
  children?: UINode[];
};

export const getWindowTreeResult = tool({
  description:
    "Get a compact UI tree for a desktop window, including element indices and screen bounds. Use this to inspect controls before deciding which UI element to interact with.",
  inputSchema: z.object({
    process: z.string().describe("Process name, such as Code or opera."),
    title: z.string().optional().describe("Optional window title."),
  }),

  execute: async ({ process, title }) => {
    try {
      const result = desktop.getWindowTreeResult(process, title, {
        formatOutput: true,
        propertyMode: Terminator.PropertyLoadingMode.Smart,
        treeOutputFormat: Terminator.TreeOutputFormat.CompactYaml,
      });

      // Save the complete result without truncating it.
      const outputPath = path.resolve("ui-tree-dump.json");
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(result, null, 2);

      await writeFile(outputPath, serialized, "utf8");

      return {
        success: true,
        process,
        title: title ?? null,
        elementCount: result.elementCount,
        filePath: outputPath,
        fileSizeBytes: Buffer.byteLength(serialized, "utf8"),
        message: "Full tree result saved to file.",
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        process,
        title: title ?? null,
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
    }
  },
});
